capabilities: Answer vault questions through a local, read-only Claude CLI session
Group citations by claim with quoted vs inferred labels
Scope a single question to a folder and its subfolders
Export answers as footnoted notes with a Sources section
Flag citations whose source files changed after the answer
disambiguation: Not a bibliography or reference manager; it answers questions about the vault with verifiable citations generated by Claude.
extras: Desktop only (needs direct filesystem access); v1 handles text/markdown files only, not PDFs, images, or canvases. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted answers you can trust by seeing exactly where every claim came from, with citations derived from Claude's real tool calls rather than its prose.
problem: LLM answers about a vault are a black box that asserts things without verifiable sources, and self-reported citations can be hallucinated.

relations.evidence: Auto-detected via a login-shell PATH lookup (same approach as Terminus)
it runs your own claude CLI locally, read-only, against your own vault

summary: AI question-answering over the vault via the local Claude CLI, with citations verified against the actual tool-call transcript and grouped by claim.
